name: Lesser Scorpion
flavour: Half the scorpion. All of the sting.
art_prompt: a small plain black desert scorpion, eight jointed legs, two pincers, one segmented tail curling over its back with one stinger, real scorpion anatomy, no face
motion: scuttling in place on its eight legs like a real scorpion, pincers held forward and open, the tail swaying above its back
anim_negative: a human face, eyebrows, a grin, teeth, standing upright, extra tails, extra pincers, legs merging
dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: its eight legs curled up limp in the air, the pincers open and limp, the tail stretched out flat on the ground

view_hints.side: the scorpion stays low and horizontal on its eight legs like a real scorpion seen from the side, body parallel to the ground, both pincers reaching forward to the right, the segmented tail curling up and over its back with the stinger above its head, never standing upright on two legs
view_hints.bd: low on its eight legs, tail curled over its back, pincers ahead of it
view_hints.fd: low on its eight legs, tail curled over its back, pincers ahead of it

doc: The second thing the hero meets: a small black scorpion with the skeleton's numbers, in fours. Three looks (LS-A plain, LS-B plates, LS-C detailed) walked on the Dune Scorpion's 3D model at half its size.
note: Pass 53 (Garry): the Dune Scorpion's rig and drivers (scorpion_walk / scorpion_death), half the size, black, no special features; three versions that differ in how much detail is painted on them.

LS-A.note: Simple: flat black, almost a silhouette, two tones

recipe.blockout: a smooth plain clay 3D model of a scorpion: eight jointed legs, two big pincers on long arms, one segmented tail curling up over its back

words.front: walking straight towards the viewer, seen from the front and a little above: its two big pincers and its head are at the bottom of the picture, nearest the viewer, the body stretches away up the picture and the one tail rises from the far end and curls up at the top
words.fd: walking towards the lower right corner of the picture, seen three-quarters from the front and a little above: the pincers and the head at the lower right, nearest the viewer, the one tail curling up at the upper left, farther away
words.bd: walking away towards the upper right corner of the picture, seen three-quarters from behind and a little above: the one tail curling up nearest the viewer at the lower left, the body and the pincers at the upper right, farther away
words.back: walking straight away from the viewer, seen from behind and a little above: its one tail rises nearest the viewer at the bottom of the picture and curls up, the body stretches away up the picture and the two pincers show at the far end, one on each side

recipe.motion: scuttling in place on its eight legs like a real scorpion, the pincers held forward, the tail swaying a little above its back
recipe.anim_negative: a human face, a grin, teeth, standing upright, two tails, extra tails, extra pincers, legs merging, a second scorpion
recipe.dead: flipped over dead on its back, its eight legs curled up limp in the air, the pincers open and limp, the one tail lying flat
recipe.detail: exactly eight jointed legs, two pincers held forward on long arms, one single segmented tail curling up and over its back ending in one curved stinger, a small low head with two tiny eyes, real scorpion anatomy, no face, no mouth, no teeth
recipe.prompt: a small plain jet-black desert scorpion painted flat in the cel-shaded anime style with crisp black line art: two flat tones, black with dark grey lit faces, smooth plates with no texture and no markings, a plain dark stinger
recipe.keep: jet-black armour all over, never brown, orange or tan; a painted cartoon look with crisp dark line art and flat cel shading in two tones, never a smooth 3D render, no surface detail, no texture
